title: Sony PSSR PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution Platform Lock-in
root_cause: PSSR uses PlayStation 5-specific ML accelerators (NN accelerators in RDNA2) without documented fallback path. Cross-platform titles must maintain separate rendering paths for PS5 vs PC/Xbox.
resolution_type: Vendor-agnostic abstraction layer. FSR 3.1 as documented fallback for non-PS5 platforms. Feature parity matrix published.
